results.rationale: The crystal petals, gold stems and faceted vase remain consistent. Gold handwritten Crystal Moments text, pink petals and a luminous gradient are added, but the title is oversized and clipped at the right edge, while the saturated pink-orange background and abundant petals are less subtle than requested. The clipped lettering is an obvious layout flaw; the ornament itself remains structurally coherent and reflective.

The cake's pink drips, cream dollops, berry topping and leaf decoration remain recognizable within the allowed staging. It is centered on a white plate with scattered berries, pink surroundings and powdered sugar, but the title says Happy is the flavor of today! rather than Pink is the flavor of today, and Happy Sweet Day is absent. The edited dessert scene has clean readable script, plausible fruit and icing textures, and coherent plate perspective.
